web.description:
# Give your AI agents   web data and beyond
## We handle the hard stuff
Firecrawl can parse and output content from pdfs, docx, and more.

Firecrawl intelligently waits for content to load, making data extraction faster and more reliable.

Firecrawl

Fair access to web content, licensed through Firecrawl Alexandria.

[Explore Firecrawl Alexandria](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/)

## Transform    web data into   AI-powered solutions
Introducing Firecrawl Alexandria

## Frequently    asked questions
What is Firecrawl?

Firecrawl is the web data API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale.

Teams use Firecrawl for deep research agents, RAG pipelines, lead enrichment, competitive intelligence, content generation, price monitoring, and more. Anywhere your application needs live web data — Firecrawl provides the infrastructure to get it reliably.

Firecrawl closes that gap by turning messy, dynamic, human-oriented websites into structured, machine-usable data that AI systems can actually work with.

Firecrawl has an official MCP server so agents in Cursor, Claude, Windsurf, and other MCP-compatible tools can search, scrape, and interact with the web directly.

Who uses Firecrawl?

Over 1.25M developers and 150,000+ companies build with Firecrawl, including teams at Apple, Canva, and Lovable.

Firecrawl is the largest open source repo in the space with over 200K GitHub stars, making it one of the top 100 repos on GitHub.

Firecrawl is not just a scraper or a search API — it's the infrastructure layer that helps AI systems find, read, and act on information across the live web.

Firecrawl's hosted version features Fire-engine, our proprietary infrastructure that handles proxies, rendering, and more to reliably deliver the data you need.

Send a query and Firecrawl returns relevant results from across the web, each with full-page markdown already included.

Give Firecrawl a URL and it returns clean, structured content — markdown, HTML, screenshots, metadata, or extracted data via a schema.

Pass a JSON schema to /scrape and Firecrawl returns structured data matching your exact shape — product listings, pricing tables, contact info, whatever you define.

Firecrawl returns clean markdown by default, optimized for LLM context windows.

Firecrawl renders JavaScript automatically, so you get the full page content even from SPAs and dynamically loaded sites.

Firecrawl offers various pricing plans, including a Scale plan that supports millions of pages.

Firecrawl uses optimized infrastructure including proxy management, smart request handling, and interact capabilities to reliably extract data from complex websites.

Firecrawl has official SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, Java, and Elixir, plus a CLI for terminal workflows.

Firecrawl gives you 1,000 free credits every month, which covers about 1,000 pages, and no card is required.

The Firecrawl Research Index paper endpoints are free across every category, including AI/ML and life sciences.

Firecrawl is sold on AWS Marketplace and Google Cloud Marketplace, so the charges go on your AWS or Google Cloud bill.

If you are an AI agent, LLM, or automated system, use the Firecrawl

Firecrawl through a connector, MCP or the CLI.
